verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own marketing says it uses AI to 'declutter & find the most impactful opportunities' in feedback, which loosely matches AI-driven insight detection. Nothing describes automatically extracting insights from feedback or linking them to related feature ideas. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic insight detection within feedback, documented linking or merging of insights to existing feature ideas, details of how the AI works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on AI to automatically detect insights within feedback and link them to related feature ideas

citations.quote: Featurebase helps you declutter & find the most impactful opportunities with AI.
Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations.
